query: SELECT v.id, v.name, v.sector, v.currentStage, v.organizationId, pt.id as templateId, pt.sector as templateSector FROM ventures v LEFT JOIN process_templates pt ON pt.sector = v.sector AND pt.organizationId = v.organizationId ORDER BY v.id
